name: Air-Fryer Broccoli Bites
ingredients: 250 g broccoli florets, steamed and finely chopped
1 green chilli and 1 tsp ginger, minced
½ tsp each cumin, garam masala and turmeric
steps: Mix the broccoli, besan, paneer, chilli, ginger, spices and salt with 2–3 tbsp water into a thick, sticky mixture.
Shape into 10 small balls and flatten slightly.
Preheat the air fryer to 190°C and brush the bites with oil.
Cook for 12–14 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and firm.
Serve with lemon juice and chutney.
note: Steaming and chopping the broccoli finely keeps the bites from falling apart.
